about.hero_intro: Full-stack web developer currently based in <1>Palagianello, Italy</1>, and originally from <2>New York City</2>.
about.hero_description_2: My passion for travel inspired me to work freelance, giving me the flexibility to explore new places while helping small businesses and companies establish their online presence.
about.hero_description_3: I specialize in building modern, responsive websites using the latest technologies to ensure my clients effectively connect with their audience.
about.hero_description_4: Since 2020, I’ve dedicated myself to the React ecosystem, blending frontend expertise with the backend logic needed to help small businesses outgrow their static sites.

frontend.title: Front-End Developer
bullets: Delivered and maintained 12+ responsive websites and React applications, development, deployment, and ongoing support.
Modernized legacy HTML, CSS, and JavaScript codebases using React, Next.js, and TypeScript, improving maintainability and accelerating feature delivery.
Built reusable, accessible components with Tailwind CSS and implemented quality checks using Vitest, React Testing Library and Playwright.
Integrated REST APIs and headless CMS platforms, enabling non-technical clients to manage content independently and reducing routine support needs.

audio_mastering.title: Audio Mastering Consultant
bullets: Edited, restored, mastered, and synchronized voice-over audio for five YouTube videos per week using iZotope RX, Reaper, and DaVinci Resolve to deliver quality consistency and meet recurring publishing deadlines.
Mastered raw voice-over to meet ACX requirements and produced audio assets for public-service announcements used by a U.S. state government and educational language-learning applications.

it_intern.title: IT Support I Intern
bullets: Executed Windows 7 to 10 OS deployment upgrades and hardware setups across staff PCs, computer labs, and networked peripherals.
Resolved Tier-1 technical support tickets using G Suite, Microsoft 365, and remote tools while managing Active Directory accounts and local networking.

invoice.title: InVoice
invoice.shortDesc: Turns voice-over scripts into itemized invoices with per-character word counts and exportable billing documents.
invoice.fullDesc: InVoice helps voice actors turn scripts into accurate invoices. It parses character dialogue, counts billable words, applies reusable rate presets, and exports PDF, DOCX, and plain-text invoices so performers spend less time on admin.
features: Parses scripts into per-character word counts for faster billing prep.
Built accessible workflows with Mantine UI components.
Used Zustand to keep single-document and multi-document tools in sync.
Added reusable rate presets and export to PDF, DOCX, and plain text.
invoice.previewAlt: InVoice dashboard showing script parser, character word counts, and invoice preview

portfolio.title: Portfolio Website v2
portfolio.shortDesc: This site — bilingual Astro + React portfolio with tested navigation, contact flow, and static deploy.
portfolio.fullDesc: Portfolio Website v2 is the site you are viewing, rebuilt for production quality. It combines restrained typography with accessibility, EN/IT localization, and a static Astro architecture with React islands for interactive sections.
features: Shipped 11 static routes with EN/IT localization and browser-language detection.
Built keyboard-accessible navigation, modals, and contact validation with Playwright coverage.
Added light/dark theme persistence with no flash on first paint.
Configured Netlify deploy, honeypot spam protection, and security headers.
portfolio.previewAlt: Portfolio site with navigation, bilingual tabs, and experience timeline

audio.intro: I restore field-recorded dialogue and mix voice content to streaming loudness targets — using iZotope RX for repair, Reaper for editing, and DaVinci Resolve for final delivery.
audio.restoration_desc: A before/after pass on dialogue recorded on location: background noise reduced, words clarified, and levels matched for podcast and video delivery.
audio.restoration_video_caption: Video walkthrough of the RX repair chain, edit decisions, and final level match.
